description: This file contains an abstract test class 'CopierTester' for testing deep copying functionality of serializers and copiers within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes test methods for verifying equality, reference handling, tuple copying, and collection copying, and manages dependency injection for copiers and serializers.

classes.description: An abstract generic class providing a framework for testing deep copying of values using serializers and copiers in Orleans.Serialization.
